newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma seizes 56 kilos of heroin near China border.
newsitem.headline: Burma seizes 56 kilos of heroin near China border.

text.p: Burmese anti-narcotics squads seized 56 kg (123 lb) of heroin in Muse, in northeast Burma near the border with China, the state-owned Myanmar News Agency (MNA) reported on Thursday.
The MNA said officials searched a van en route to China and found 160 blocks of heroin hidden in the compartment of a spare fuel tank.
A total of 125.02 kg (275 lb) of heroin were seized through the end of February, and the government confiscated 504.5 kg (1,109.9 lb) of the drug in 1996, official statistics showed.
